title: scrophularia grayana var. borealikoreana
intro: Scrophularia grayana var. borealikoreana, commonly known as Boreal Korean figwort, is a plant species belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Korea, to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Boreal Korean figwort include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory infections due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
